description: Returns a ballpark cost, budget range, or line-item needs estimate for a live event (party, birthday, wedding, corporate offsite, conference, concert, festival, gala, fundraiser, and similar). No login. Takes a plain-language description (for example "rooftop birthday in Austin Friday night for 50 people with a DJ and tacos") and returns an illustrative low/mid/high estimate, line-item breakdown (labor, production, add-ons, logistics), suggested deposit, assumptions, confidence, missing information, and evidence pointers. Numbers come from the versioned SYNTHETIC pricing catalog and a deterministic engine — not model-invented prices. The catalog is illustrative: not real cost of goods and not a binding vendor quote (request_booking contacts an organization for a binding price). A returned quote_id plus overridden requirements refines an estimate. Optional use_ai_grounding (default off) may fill only event type, location, and date; it never supplies a number; the pasted text is sent to a third-party AI provider, Anthropic (Claude), through the Vercel AI Gateway with zero-data-retention routing requested; Soundcheck does not save it to any event or account (https://soundchecklive.io/privacy).

description.description: free-text event description, e.g. "Two-day outdoor music festival in Austin, ~3,000 attendees, LED wall and livestream". Required unless quote_id is given.

location.description: city, metro, or venue name used to resolve the market index

quote_id.description: a quote_id from an earlier quote_event call, to refine instead of starting over

requirements.description: structured overrides; they win over anything read from the description

addons.description: catalog add-on ids or labels, e.g. led_wall, livestream, rigging

event_type.description: catalog event profile id or label, e.g. festival, corporate, wedding

venue_id.description: seeded places-catalog venue id, e.g. venue_red-rocks-amphitheatre

use_ai_grounding.description: opt in to one AI normalization pass that may fill ONLY event type, location/venue, and date. Never supplies a number. Default false. When true, the pasted text is sent to a third-party AI provider, Anthropic (Claude), through the Vercel AI Gateway with zero-data-retention routing requested; Soundcheck does not save it to any event or account (https://soundchecklive.io/privacy).
